Definition: from G5453 (compare G5444); an offshoot, i.e. race or clan:--kindred, tribe.
BiblicalUsage: Phyle is a tribe, a kindred, a people bound by blood. Paul calls himself of the tribe of Benjamin in Philippians 3:5, and Jesus promises the twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel in Matthew 19:28. Revelation 5:5 names the Lion of the tribe of Juda, and Revelation 7:4 seals twelve thousand from every tribe of the children of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps His promises tribe by tribe, name by name — no one is lost in the crowd. That is why I hold that belonging to His people is personal, not just national.
RelatedTopics: Covenant; Israel's identity; Kingdom of God
